tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find MCP servers and Agent Skills for a dev task. Free-text query (every term must match name, vendor, verdict, install or category; common words like postgres, e2e, scraping are expanded) and optional category slug from list_categories (a dev task such as 'database' or a type such as 'agent-skill')

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Full card for one catalog entry by slug (e.g. 'github-mcp-server'): verdict, install command, credentials, permissions, license, source and maintenance status.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All dev-task categories and entry types with entry counts and page URLs.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_entry" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
